card.name: Hyphen inside dates and trial codes
card.fires_on: The hyphen right after a four-digit year in a numeric date such as 2011-03-18. It also fires on a hyphen inside trial or protein names, such as BIG 1-98, P-1 and interleukin-6.

modes.label: Dates
modes.description: Hyphen after the year in a year-month-day timestamp, such as a last-modified line or a post date.

modes.label: Trial and protein names
modes.description: Hyphen inside a named study or a cytokine name before a number or letter.

card.writes: It strongly lowers the chance of another dash or hyphen character coming next, which fits a hyphen having just been written.
card.plain: It marks the hyphen in a date like 2011-03-18 or in a study name like BIG 1-98.
